items.title: 11.4.3 Graph of y = cos x from - 2pi to 2pi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 207-209: 11.4.3 Graph of y = cos x: range lines, table x / cos x, graphs 0 to 360 and -360 to 360, properties (i)-(xi); (vii) prints minimum 1 for -1.

blocks.text: Sine ka graph ban gaya; ab uska jurwan bhai, cosine. Achhi khabar yeh hai ke cosine ka graph banana sine se bhi aasan hai, kyun ke shakal bilkul wahi lehar hai, bas jagah thori khisak jati hai. Is sabaq mein hum dekhenge ke yeh khiskao kitna hai aur kyun hai.
Kitab kehti hai: cosine function ka period bhi \(2\pi\) hai, is liye pehle hum graph \(0^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\) (yani \(0\) se \(2\pi\)) tak banayenge.
Cosine function ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai, is liye yeh graph bhi horizontal lines \(y = +1\) aur \(y = -1\) ke darmiyan rahega.
\(y = \cos x\) ko satisfy karne wale ordered pairs ki table yeh hai:

blocks.caption: Ordered pairs satisfying \(y = \cos x\), \(0 \le x \le 2\pi\) (printed across the page in the book; turned on its side here to fit a phone)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is table ko 11.4.2 wali sine table ke saath rakh kar dekhiye: numbers wahi hain, bas aage peeche ho gaye hain. \(\cos 0^{\circ} = 1\) wahi hai jo \(\sin 90^{\circ}\) tha; \(\cos 30^{\circ} = 0.87\) wahi hai jo \(\sin 120^{\circ}\) tha. Aam qaida: \(\cos x = \sin(x + 90^{\circ})\). Matlab cosine ka graph, sine ke graph ko \(90^{\circ}\) bayen (left) khiskane se ban jata hai.
Values khud bhi nikal sakte hain: \(\cos 120^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = -\cos 60^{\circ} = -0.5\), aur \(\cos 300^{\circ} = \cos(360^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ} = 0.5\).
\(y = \cos x\) ka \(0^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\) tak graph neeche diya gaya hai:

blocks.alt: Graph of y = cos x from 0 to 360 degrees. Magenta axes; the x-axis is marked every 30 degrees, the y-axis has small ticks every 0.1 and labels 1, .5, minus .5, minus 1, with dashed lines y = 1 and y = minus 1. The smooth wave (no dots, as printed) starts at the maximum (0, 1), crosses the x-axis at 90 degrees, reaches the minimum (180, minus 1), crosses again at 270 degrees and returns to (360, 1).
blocks.caption: Graph of y = cos x from 0° to 360° (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph banane ke steps wahi hain jo sine mein the: scale (\(x\)-axis par har chhota khana \(10^{\circ}\), \(y\)-axis par bara khana 1 unit), axes, 13 points plot, aur ek smooth curve. Farq sirf shuru ka hai: cosine ka curve origin se nahin, balke sab se oonche point \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai.
Is graph ko parhiye: \(0^{\circ}\) par \(1\), \(90^{\circ}\) par \(0\), \(180^{\circ}\) par \(-1\) (sab se neeche), \(270^{\circ}\) par phir \(0\), aur \(360^{\circ}\) par wapas \(1\). Quadrant I aur IV mein curve upar (positive), II aur III mein neeche (negative): yeh bilkul cosine ke quadrant wale signs hain.

Isi tarah \(0^{\circ}\) se \(-360^{\circ}\) tak ka graph bhi banaya ja sakta hai. Is se \(y = \cos x\) ka graph \(-360^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\), yani \(-2\pi\) se \(2\pi\) tak mukammal ho jata hai, jo neeche diya gaya hai:

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Negative angles ke liye \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\), jaise \(\cos(-60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ} = 0.5\). Yani minus angle ka cosine par koi asar nahin. Is ka natija: graph ka bayan hissa dayen hisse ka aaine wala aks (mirror image) hai, \(y\)-axis aaina hai. Sine mein aisa nahin tha; wahan bayan hissa ulta (upside down) tha.

blocks.alt: Graph of y = cos x from minus 360 to 360 degrees, x-axis marked every 30 degrees, y labels 1, .5, minus .5, minus 1. Two complete waves between the dashed lines y = 1 and y = minus 1: maxima at minus 360, 0 and 360 degrees, minima at minus 180 and 180 degrees, zeros at minus 270, minus 90, 90 and 270 degrees. Dots at the 30-degree points that are not multiples of 90 degrees. The graph is a mirror image about the y-axis.
blocks.caption: Graph of y = cos x from −360° to 360° (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Sine graph ki tarah cosine graph bhi \(x\)-axis ki dono taraf har \(2\pi\) ke interval mein aage barhaya jata hai.
Properties of graph of cosine function (y = cos x)
Ab kitab cosine graph ki gyarah properties batati hai. Inhein bhi graph par dekh dekh kar parhiye:

items: (i) Domain tamam real numbers ka set hai \((-\infty < x < \infty)\): har angle ka cosine maujood hai.
(ii) Range mein \(-1\) se \(1\) tak ke tamam real numbers shamil hain, dono kinare bhi: \([-1, 1]\).
(iii) Cosine ka graph tamam real numbers par continuous hai, kahin toot-ta nahin.
(iv) Cosine function ka period \(2\pi\) hai. Formula ki zubaan mein: \(\cos(\theta + 2\pi) = \cos\theta\).
(v) Cosine even function hai, kyun ke us ka graph \(y\)-axis ke gird symmetric hai (aaine ki tarah). Formula: \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\).
(vi) \(y = \cos x\) ki maximum value \(1\) hai, jab \(x = \pi n\) aur \(n\) even integer ho (\(0, \pm 2, \pm 4, \dots\)).
(vii) \(y = \cos x\) ki minimum value \(-1\) hai, jab \(x = \pi n\) aur \(n\) odd integer ho (\(\pm 1, \pm 3, \dots\)).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab property (vii) mein \(y = \cos x\) ki minimum value \(1\) chhapti hai; minus ka nishan reh gaya hai. Sahi: \(y = \cos x\) ki minimum value \(-1\) hai, jab \(x = \pi n\) aur \(n\) odd ho, jaise \(\cos 180^{\circ} = -1\). Minimum \(1\) ho hi nahin sakti, kyun ke \(1\) to maximum hai (property (vi)). Hum ne upar sahi value likhi hai.

items: (viii) Cosine ka \(x\)-intercept (jahan graph \(x\)-axis ko kaatta hai) \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} + \pi n\) par hota hai, jahan \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\).
(ix) Cosine ka \(y\)-intercept \(1\) hai: graph \(y\)-axis ko \((0, 1)\) par kaatta hai.
(x) Cosine function ka amplitude (lehar ki unchai) \(1\) hai.
(xi) Unit circle mein \(\cos\theta\) diye gaye point ke \(x\)-coordinate ke barabar hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Graph par check kijiye:
(vi) even \(n = -2, 0, 2\) se \(-360^{\circ}, 0^{\circ}, 360^{\circ}\): teeno chotiyan (peaks).
(vii) odd \(n = -1, 1\) se \(-180^{\circ}, 180^{\circ}\): dono sab se neeche wale points.
(viii) \(n = -2, -1, 0, 1\) se \(-270^{\circ}, -90^{\circ}, 90^{\circ}, 270^{\circ}\): jahan curve \(x\)-axis ko kaatta hai.
(xi) unit circle par point \((\cos\theta, \sin\theta)\) hai; cosine us point ka \(x\)-coordinate, yani daayen bayen ka faasla hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh kitab ka sawal nahin, practice ke liye hai. Graph ki madad se batayiye ke \(0^{\circ}\) se \(360^{\circ}\) ke darmiyan kin angles par \(\cos x = 0.5\) hai.
Soch: \(y = 0.5\) par ek horizontal line khenchiye. Yeh cosine curve ko do jagah kaatti hai. Table se pehli jagah \(60^{\circ}\) hai, kyun ke \(\cos 60^{\circ} = 0.5\). Doosri jagah ke liye even property aur period dono kaam aate hain: \(\cos(360^{\circ} - 60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ}\), yani \(300^{\circ}\).
Jawab: \(x = 60^{\circ}\) aur \(x = 300^{\circ}\). Tasdeeq: table mein \(300^{\circ}\) ke neeche bhi \(0.5\) likha hai.
Is se ek ahem baat seekhne ko milti hai: \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan har value ko cosine ek cycle mein do dafa leta hai (sirf \(1\) aur \(-1\) ek dafa), kyun ke lehar ek dafa neeche jati hai aur ek dafa ooper aati hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Unit circle se cosine ki lehar kaise banti hai? Ek point \(P\) ko unit circle par \((1, 0)\) se shuru kar ke ghumaiye. Is ka \(x\)-coordinate hi \(\cos\theta\) hai. Shuru mein \(P\) bilkul dayen hai, to \(x = 1\). Ooper \(90^{\circ}\) par pahunche to \(x = 0\). Bayen \(180^{\circ}\) par \(x = -1\). Neeche \(270^{\circ}\) par phir \(0\), aur poora chakkar laga kar \(360^{\circ}\) par wapas \(1\). Yahi \(1, 0, -1, 0, 1\) cosine graph ke paanch khaas points hain. Yaani graph darasal ek ghoomte hue point ki daayen-bayen harkat ki tasveer hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: \(\cos 720^{\circ}\) kitna hoga? \(720^{\circ} = 2 \times 360^{\circ}\), yani do poore chakkar, to value wahi jo \(0^{\circ}\) par: \(1\). Property (vi) se bhi: \(720^{\circ} = 4\pi\), \(n = 4\) even hai, is liye maximum \(1\). Ab aap batayein: \(\cos 540^{\circ}\)? (Ishara: \(540^{\circ} = 3\pi\), \(n = 3\) odd.) Jawab: \(-1\).

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Sketch mein sine aur cosine aksar gadmad ho jate hain. Ek point se test kijiye: \(x = 0\) par \(\sin 0 = 0\) (graph origin se shuru) lekin \(\cos 0 = 1\) (graph oopar se shuru). Bas yeh ek baat yaad rakhein to kabhi ghalti nahin hogi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Shakal sine wali, bas \(90^{\circ}\) bayen khiski hui: \(\cos x = \sin(x + 90^{\circ})\).
2. Range \([-1, 1]\), period \(2\pi\), amplitude \(1\), har jagah continuous.
3. Chotiyan \(\pi\) ke even multiples par, sab se neeche (\(-1\)) odd multiples par.
4. Zeros \(\frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\) par; \(y\)-intercept \(1\).
5. Even function: graph \(y\)-axis ke gird symmetric hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Kitab ki chhapai ki ghalti copy kar lena: cosine ki minimum value \(-1\) hai, \(1\) nahin.
2. Cosine ke zeros \(0, \pi, 2\pi\) par laga dena: woh sine ke zeros hain. Cosine \(90^{\circ}\) aur \(270^{\circ}\) par zero hota hai.
3. Bayan hissa ulta bana dena: cosine mein bayan hissa aaine wala aks hai, kyun ke \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\).
4. Table mein \(\cos 90^{\circ}\) ko \(1\) likh dena (yeh \(\sin 90^{\circ}\) hai). \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\).
